dataset: OS OpenMap Local technical specification — ImportantBuilding
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap Local technical specification defines ImportantBuilding as a generalised building belonging to a FunctionalSite. The same feature type carries BuildingTheme, classification, distinctiveName, featureCode and a required GM_Surface geometry described as a polygon representing the generalised important building. The selected public specification page provides schema-level evidence only and contains no individual Exeter ImportantBuilding feature, identifier or polygon coordinates.

field_evidence.footprint: ImportantBuilding geometry is specified as a required GM_Surface polygon representing the generalised important building; no individual Exeter polygon coordinates appear in the selected document window.
field_evidence.type_use: The same ImportantBuilding feature type includes BuildingTheme, classification and distinctiveName attributes, directly binding building function/name semantics to the feature schema.
field_evidence.retrieval: The official Ordnance Survey public PDF technical specification was read without login; page 45 contains the ImportantBuilding feature definition.
